item.title: Commentary: Public health requires communiy action
item.description: While it will always be wise to ensure you are giving informed consent to medical decisions, the purpose of the HHS is to provide evidence-based recommendations that the scientific community at large agrees to be the most beneficial for public health. In its current state, the HHS is not carrying out this function. This unfortunately means that a burden has been placed on those with the ability to more carefully think through their medical decisions, no matter how small or seemingly unimportant.
